assumptions: consistency: logged reward corresponds to the logged action
positivity: every target-supported action has logging probability above the frozen threshold
conditional exchangeability is not guaranteed by observational logging and observational evidence remains non-causal
outcome model is trained outside the evaluation corpus under a declared split
same frozen mature corpus is used for baseline and candidate policy replay
no interference or hidden cross-account exposure contamination
propensity vectors are exact source-bound logging probabilities rather than reconstructed post-hoc guesses
limitations: offline replay cannot prove live canary safety
doubly-robust estimation is only robust when at least one of the propensity or outcome models is valid under its assumptions
unmeasured confounding can invalidate causal interpretation
limited overlap increases variance and extrapolation risk
critical guardrail or stratum reversals veto promotion even when aggregate primary effect is positive
